The '''Dervdis system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of article of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] known as the [[Dervdisi fashioned suit]].<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Dervdisi fashioned suit]]|system=Dervdis [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dervdis [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
